about: The App Store's app preview: 886x1920 (every iPhone size group takes it), cut from the iPhone simulator's takes on the Mac (capture-ios: an App Store preview must show the iPhone app). Named 01_IPHONE_67 so deliver files it under the 6.9-inch iPhones; edit --install copies it to ios/fastlane/app_previews/en-US/. The poster frame is 5 s in (the Fastfile's preview_frame_time_code). in and out are seconds from each take's zero, first guesses: set them from make_preview.py plan once captured. Captions never name another platform (guideline 2.3.10).
